column1: # RidgeFill calibration documents: one row per document (chat copies included). The texts and their sources
# are not released; documents are identified by their names in the fit records and by sha256 of their text.
# sha256: SHA-256 of the document text encoded as UTF-8, exactly as stored in the calibration plan and passed
#   to the tokenizer (chat copies: the copy as captured, chat frame included); chars: Unicode code points.
# role: fit = map fit document of every reference map, the Qwen3.8-27B map and the Flash-Next map;
#   flashnext-fit = Flash-Next map only; chat-copy = Flash-Next chat-formatted copy (chattrain/, chatbig/ fit;
#   chatheld/ lambda choice); lambda = held-out lambda-choice document; sterm = terminal-state correction prompt;
#   excluded-token-table = excluded from every map fit, still counted by the token-frequency table.
# used_by: the users whose fit records name the document (reference = Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3.5-9B, Qwen3-8B
#   maps; qwen38-27b; flashnext); for excluded-token-table rows, the users of the token-frequency table.
# tokens_llama-3.1-8b-instruct: token count of the text, no BOS, not truncated (tokenizer.json sha256 6b9e4e7fb171f92fd137b777cc2714bf87d11576700a1dcd7a399e7bbe39537b).
# tokens_qwen3.5-9b: token count of the text, no BOS, not truncated (tokenizer.json sha256 5f9e4d4901a92b997e463c1f46055088b6cca5ca61a6522d1b9f64c4bb81cb42).
# tokens_qwen3-8b: token count of the text, no BOS, not truncated (tokenizer.json sha256 aeb13307a71acd8fe81861d94ad54ab689df773318809eed3cbe794b4492dae4).
# tokens_qwen3.8: token count of the text, no BOS, not truncated (tokenizer.json sha256 0997f410c57a1f4e53b09e4be8f4a172d90edd9564368fb0847030937229b9f3).
# tokens_qwen3.8: the one tokenizer.json that Qwen3.8-27B and Qwen3.8-Flash-Next share.
# sterm used_by: no reference final cell uses a terminal-state correction, so the reference sterm sweep records are not counted.
# excluded-token-table used_by qwen38-27b: the Qwen3.8-27B release's row table is the Flash-Next release's, unchanged.
# Fit rows = sum over a map's fit documents of min(tokens + BOS, 32768); BOS is 1 for Llama-3.1-8B, else 0.
